title: False complaints under this law - legal remedies for the accused
p1:
A complaint can start a legal battle, but does it always mean the accused is guilty?

Many people assume that once a case is filed, the accused has no options left. That is not true.
p2: A lesser-known fact is that the law also recognizes misuse of legal provisions. If a complaint is found to be false, malicious, or filed with improper intent, the accused may have legal remedies available instead of simply accepting the allegations.
p3:
The accused can challenge the proceedings through appropriate legal channels, present evidence showing inconsistencies, and seek relief from the court depending on the facts of the case. The key is to respond legally and strategically rather than reacting emotionally.

Every complaint deserves a fair investigation, and every accused person has the right to defend themselves.
